scan_hero_subtitle: Paste a message, link, or upload a QR code — we'll tell you if it's safe.
scan_placeholder_message: Paste the suspicious SMS or WhatsApp message here…
scan_drop_qr: Drag & drop a QR image here, or click to choose a file
scan_drop_hint: Supports JPEG, PNG, WebP · Max 5 MB
upi_send_warning: Scanning this QR will SEND money from your account. You NEVER need to scan a QR to RECEIVE money — that is always a scam.
history_delete_all_confirm: Delete your entire scan history? This cannot be undone.
history_empty: No scans yet. Go to the Scan page to check a message.
learn_subtitle: Understand every warning we give — in plain language.
about_subtitle: A student project on Cyber Security — built to protect people from mobile scams.
about_subject: Subject: Cyber Security in Mobile, Cloud and IoT (B.Sc.-IT(Hons.) Sem 5)
about_how_1: You paste a message, link, or QR code.
about_how_2: ScamShield scans it instantly — on your device, nothing is sent anywhere.
about_how_3: You get a plain-language verdict: Safe, Suspicious, or Dangerous.
about_how_4: Tap 'Learn Why' on any warning to understand exactly what the scammer was trying.
about_privacy_body: Everything runs on your computer. We never send your messages to any server, never open any link, and never store more than the first 60 characters of any scan.
err_empty: Please enter some text before checking.
err_too_long: That message is too long. Please keep it under 10,000 characters.
err_bad_file_type: Unsupported file type. Please upload a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.
err_file_too_large: Image is too large. Please use a file smaller than 5 MB.
err_no_qr: No QR code found in this image. Make sure the QR code is clearly visible.
err_server: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err_network: Cannot reach the server. Please check that the app is running.
footer_privacy: Nothing you scan is ever sent to the internet.
footer_built: Built for B.Sc.-IT(Hons.) Sem 5 — Cyber Security
